model_output: In Strickland v. Washington, 466 U.S. 668 (1984), the Court held that effective assistance requires both deficient performance and prejudice. See also Teague v. Lane, 489 U.S. 288 (1989), and Brady v. Maryland, 378 U.S. 478 (1963).
The applicable standard derives from 205 A.3d 445 and State v. Rodriguez, 162 Idaho 763 (2017). The rule from 127 Hawai'i 126 is distinguishable.
The court in 84 So.3d 1032 (Fla. 4th DCA 2011) established the framework. Also cited are 36 So.3d 84, 79 So.3d 745, and 130 So.3d 1277.
Under Texas law, see 56 S.W.3d 842 (Tex. App. 2001) and 372 S.W.3d 177 (Tex. App. 2012). The Supreme Court's analysis in 118 S. Ct. 2091 (1998) is also instructive.
The Hawai'i Supreme Court in 127 Hawai'i 126 (2012) and the Pacific Reporter at 813 P.2d 1384 (1991) both support this interpretation.
